original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家呼吁培育耐旱油棕品种以提高产量
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚油棕行业专家呼吁改进油棕育种策略，培育耐旱品种以维持高产、增强农民生计并应对气候变化挑战。马来西亚棕榈油局专家在贝宁的讲座中表示，相关研究正在利用东南亚和非洲种质资源筛选耐旱种植材料。尼日利亚油棕研究所负责人鼓励与会者学习专家经验。

key_facts.fact: 专家呼吁改进油棕育种策略以培育耐旱品种
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Experts in the palm oil sector have called for improved oil palm breeding strategies to develop drought-tolerant varieties that sustain high yields

key_facts.fact: 马来西亚棕榈油局专家在贝宁发表关于高产与耐旱育种的讲座
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Dr Rajinder Singh, an expert at the Advanced Biotechnology and Breeding Centre of the Malaysian Palm Oil Board, made the call on Thursday in Benin while delivering a lecture on breeding for high yield and drought tolerance

key_facts.fact: 研究正在利用东南亚和非洲种质资源筛选耐旱种植材料
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: research was ongoing to identify drought-tolerant planting materials, using Southeast Asian and African germplasm, as well as shell mutations, as benchmarks

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚油棕研究所负责人鼓励与会者应用所学知识
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Executive Director/Chief Executive of the Nigerian Institute for Oil Palm Research, Dr Isona Gold, urged participants to maximise the opportunity to learn from experts and apply the knowledge gained to their work

uncertainties: 该报道为单一来源（尼日利亚通讯社），尚缺乏其他独立来源交叉验证
